verdicts.reason: A: the magnifier icon sits outside its search box, which leaves an empty divided cell; the orange panel stops short with a dead white band underneath; the photo floats with uneven white margins and its bottom edge doesn't line up with the panel. Still, the headline hierarchy and padding are clean. B is worse: 'HOW TO LEVEL UP' breaks onto two lines jammed into the panel's top-left corner, 'ONLINE COURSE' runs almost edge to edge with no breathing room, the magnifier spills over the panel's right edge, and the white margins around the panel and photo are uneven.
